entities.name: SubQuadratic
entities.how_described: 本集主角:Alex 联合创办的公司,使命是做出计算、内存和采样效率最高的算法并在其上构建基础模型;用单模型同时完成选择与生成的稀疏注意力机制解决注意力的平方成本问题,号称在 B200/B300 上比 Flash Attention 快约 40 倍、计算量少 64 倍。

evidence.quote: I'm Alex, co-founder and CTO here at SubQuadratic.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

entities.name: 稀疏注意力 (sparse attention)
entities.how_described: 本集核心概念:只对重要的那部分 token 关系跑注意力来绕开二次方开销;历史上的固定模式(如滑动窗口)不能稳健建模语言,动态选择(DeepSeek)可行但引入全注意力成本,SubQuadratic 声称用单模型边生成边选择两全其美。

evidence.quote: Yeah, and can you explain, you've tackled this quadratic complexity with sparse attention, am I right?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And can you explain what sparse attention is in simple terms and why it matters compared to standard transformer attention?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Sparse attention says we don't actually need all of those token relationships.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: And so sparse attention attempts to find which token relationships are important before running attention on only a subset of the token relationships.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: And one of the main challenges with sparse attention is that there's always been a quality trade-off, as you can imagine.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: And so the challenge of sparse attention has been figuring out which ones actually matter.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: Most sparse attention mechanisms have used fixed patterns.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: DeepSeek Sparse Attention upended this by saying we're actually going to use a separate prediction model to determine which tokens are important.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: In fact, that separate selection model uses more compute than the sparse attention layers in the full model at just 52,000 tokens and then continuously grows to an even larger differential.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: And so what we've done that's unique is we have a sparse attention mechanism that, like DeepSeek sparse attention, dynamically selects the token relationships, but does so without the massive cost of full attention and does so without a separate selection mechanism.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: I mean, the problem with sparse attention historically has been that they're fixed pattern mechanisms, like sliding window attention, look at the last 1000 tokens that are closest, or before and after.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: And so while DeepSeek Sparse Attention uses a separate model to do that, reintroducing the quadratic problem, we do not.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: So the model, you use sparse attention, and how does the model decide what tokens to pay attention to?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: I feel like sparse attention could also reduce noise and lead to better results.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

entities.name: 智能体 (agent)

evidence.quote: You can now pull a lot more context and do a lot more work with every single step in your agent workflow.

entities.name: 预训练 (pre-training)
